methodologyNotes: Roster covers eight high-search CPU coolers spanning AIO liquid and air categories: Arctic Liquid Freezer III 360, NZXT Kraken Elite 360 RGB (2024), Corsair iCUE H150i Elite Capellix XT, Noctua NH-D15 G2, Deepcool LS720, Thermalright Peerless Assassin 120 SE, be quiet! Dark Rock Pro 5, and Lian Li Galahad II Trinity Performance 360. Sources consulted include manufacturer product pages (arctic.de, noctua.at, bequiet.com, deepcool.com, lian-li.com, thermalright.com, corsair.com, nzxt.com), retailer listings (Newegg, Amazon, Micro Center, Best Buy), and independent reviews (GamersNexus, Tom's Hardware, TechPowerUp, KitGuru). Specs strings carry units where applicable (e.g. "360 mm", "168 mm"); booleans indicate yes/no features; noise_dba_max is the manufacturer-rated or reviewer-measured peak dB(A) at 100% fan speed; tdp_rating_w is the manufacturer-stated maximum dissipation where published, otherwise null. Adversarial re-verification 2026-06-15: corrected Corsair socket list (removed LGA1851, which the XT does not support per the official Corsair page and Amazon listing) and nulled Thermalright PA120 SE tdp_rating_w (Thermalright does not publish a hard numeric TDP ceiling; spec pages state only "TDP exceeding 200 W" — a null beats an unsourced 265 W). accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Arctic Liquid Freezer III 360

specs.socket_support: Intel LGA1700, LGA1851, AMD AM4, AM5 (LGA1200/115x via optional kit)

products.provenance: Release date October 18, 2023 confirmed via GamersNexus review. Launch MSRP $130 for black variant confirmed by multiple sources (A-RGB SKU $150). Noise at 100% fan speed ~40 dBA from GamersNexus testing (20-inch, non-chamber method). Official Arctic page confirms black non-RGB variant, 360 mm radiator, three P12 fans plus a 60 mm VRM fan, LGA1700/LGA1851 + AM4/AM5 native (LGA1200/115x via optional kit). Arctic does not publish a TDP ceiling so that field is null.

products.name: NZXT Kraken Elite 360 RGB (2024)
products.priceNote: Current MSRP (black RL-KR36E-B2) as of June 2026; white ~$249.99

specs.socket_support: Intel LGA1851, LGA1700, LGA1200/115x; AMD AM5, AM4

products.provenance: Released August 2024. Specs and socket support confirmed from official NZXT product page (Intel LGA1851/1700/1200/115X; AMD AM5/AM4). Fan noise 30.00 dBA per fan confirmed on NZXT product page. Three 120mm F360 RGB Core fans on a 401x120x27 mm radiator. Current black-model price $279.99 observed across multiple sources June 2026. NZXT does not publish a TDP ceiling; field left null. Features a 2.72-inch (640x640) IPS LCD.

products.name: Corsair iCUE H150i Elite Capellix XT

specs.socket_support: Intel LGA1700, LGA1200, LGA115x, LGA2011, LGA2066; AMD AM5, AM4, sTRX4/sTR4

products.provenance: Release date February 2, 2023 confirmed via official Corsair press release. Socket support corrected: official Corsair product page and Amazon listing show Intel LGA115X/1200/1700/2011/2066 and AMD AM5/AM4/sTRX4/sTR4 — the draft's inclusion of LGA1851 was wrong (the XT predates LGA1851) and has been removed. Three AF120 RGB Elite fans, 360 mm radiator. Max fan noise 34.1 dBA from Corsair specs (5-34.1 dB range, 550-2100 RPM). Corsair does not publish a TDP ceiling; field left null. Price reflects current typical US street pricing.

products.name: Noctua NH-D15 G2
products.priceNote: MSRP at launch July 2024; currently ~$165-180 at Amazon

specs.socket_support: Intel LGA1851, LGA1700, LGA1200, LGA115x; AMD AM5, AM4

products.provenance: Release date July 2, 2024 and launch MSRP $149.95 confirmed via Tom's Hardware. Height 168 mm, dual NF-A14x25r G2 PWM fans (max 1500 rpm, eight heatpipes), max noise 24.8 dBA per fan confirmed via Noctua spec page and multiple reviews. Socket support (LGA1851/1700/1200/115x + AM5/AM4) confirmed from Noctua compatibility page. Noctua does not publish a numeric TDP ceiling; field left null. No RGB.

products.name: Deepcool LS720
products.priceNote: Typical US street price at launch and thereafter

products.provenance: Release date July 5, 2022 confirmed via DeepCool press release. Full-load fan noise ≤32.9 dB(A) (pump 19 dB(A)) confirmed on official DeepCool product page. Three FC120 A-RGB fans on a 360 mm (402x120x27 mm) radiator. Socket support confirmed from DeepCool page (Intel LGA2066/2011-v3/2011/1700/1200/1151/1150/1155; AMD sTRX4/sTR4/AM5/AM4). DeepCool does not publish a numeric TDP ceiling; field left null. Price $139.99 from US retailer listings. Removed the original draft's stale LGA1851-path source URL alias in favor of the canonical /2022/ product page.

products.name: Thermalright Peerless Assassin 120 SE
products.priceNote: Typical US street price; reviewed September 2022 at ~$36

specs.socket_support: Intel LGA1851, LGA1700, LGA1200, LGA1151, LGA1155, LGA1156; AMD AM5, AM4

products.provenance: Height 155 mm, two TL-C12C fans, six heat pipes, noise 25.6 dBA, and socket support confirmed via Thermalright product page and spec aggregator. tdp_rating_w corrected from 265 to null: Thermalright does not publish a hard numeric TDP ceiling for the PA120 SE — the spec page states only "designed for CPUs with a TDP exceeding 200 W," and the 265 W figure is an unsourced aggregator estimate, so a null beats a guess. Price ~$35 confirmed by pcspecchart (Amazon $35) and Micro Center ($49.99 retail). No RGB on standard SE variant (ARGB SKU is separate).

products.name: be quiet! Dark Rock Pro 5

specs.socket_support: Intel LGA1851, LGA1700, LGA1200, LGA1150, LGA1151, LGA1155; AMD AM5, AM4

products.provenance: Launch date October 24, 2023 confirmed via PC Perspective and be quiet! press coverage. Height 168 mm, TDP 270 W, noise 23.3 dB(A) at 100% PWM, two fans, and socket support (Intel LGA1851/1700/1200/1150/1151/1155; AMD AM5/AM4) confirmed on official be quiet! product page. Fan complement is one Silent Wings 135 mm plus one 120 mm PWM fan. MSRP $99.90 USD confirmed by multiple US retailers (official page lists €104.90 RRP). No RGB.
